title: Standby LP → Fire Princess planning and fail-closed atomic persistence gate

scenarios: Dancing Fairy (1000 LP) + Fire Princess (500 damage): the active Standby planner computes the exact team-0 result while preserving physical owner seat; a separate clean persisted snapshot with the same unadmitted candidates is rejected by duel integrity before storage, and the store returns invalid-tag-session-state with revision, LP and ledgers unchanged.

Darklord Marie (200 LP) + Fire Princess (500 damage): activation-time UID snapshot and team-1 routing are correct; a separate clean persisted snapshot containing the unadmitted candidates is rejected at the duel-integrity boundary before any partial storage write.
A certified-only TagDuel state accepts a generic M452 LP plan; M454 commits both LP totals and both ledgers atomically, duplicate retry is idempotent, and a stale session revision is rejected.

admissionGate.observed: The current M454 base catalog does not admit the Standby/Fire Princess candidate IDs. A clean TagDuel snapshot containing those IDs is rejected by duel integrity as an unknown card identity; the storage boundary maps that validation failure to invalid-tag-session-state before changing revision, LP totals or ledgers.
admissionGate.nextRequirement: Complete card admission/certification through the normal behavioral gate before allowing these source cards into a persisted TagDuel session.

limitations: The successful atomic commit case uses a certified-only state and a generic LP gain with no Fire Princess on the field.
No central resolver registration; M61 handoff remains pending.
No live Discord credentials or production session are used.

The planner scenarios run with an active in-memory Standby continuation; persistence rejection is exercised against a separate clean snapshot containing the same unadmitted card candidates, isolating admission from continuation validation.
